correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the characteristic-2 geometry for F=x²y²+y²z²+z²x²+xyzw. Viewed as linear in w, coefficient xyz is coprime to the other summand, so F is absolutely irreducible. Quadrics [tu:su:st:s²+t²+u²] have no common projective zero and satisfy F=0; the inverse [yz:xz:xy] on xyz!=0 makes the map birational. Fibres over the three singular lines are finite, hence projective quasi-finite map is finite and P² normalization. Partial derivatives are (yzw,xzw,xyw,xyz), and exactly >=2 of x,y,z vanish on the singular support. Chart w=1 yields reduced (xy,xz,yz), while chart x=1 yields (yz,yw,zw,y²+z²), generically (y,z) off w=0; y,z,y²=z² are independent w-annihilated torsion classes of length 3 and all others follow by symmetry. On the dominant source line, lambda=v+v^-1 is separable degree 2, unique characteristic-2 branch v=1 with lambda=h²/(1+h), wild e=2 and different exponent 2 by Riemann-Hurwitz. Projective torus and boundary count (q-1)^2+3q+1=q²+q+2 implies the stated zeta function. Independently derived partials, charts and local Groebner ideals and enumerated GF(2), GF(4), with (surface,singular)=(8,7),(22,13). These finite tests cannot certify algebraic closure or all extensions, which rest on the proof.

value.rationale: The Roman quartic is a standard natural projected Veronese surface. Its characteristic-two exceptional fibre retains the classical three reduced double lines but acquires distinct intrinsic Jacobian torsion at exactly three wild endpoint points. Specifying local torsion length three, its module generators and the different exponent on the normalized double-line covers gives motivated scheme-level information invisible in set-theoretic singularity counts, and is useful as exact data for studying conductor, normalization and degeneration. The zeta function and P² normalization are explicitly treated as context rather than independent novelty. This is not an arbitrary numerical slice or routine invariant lookup; it identifies a concrete structural exceptional-characteristic phenomenon.
residual_risks: Scope is one explicitly chosen equation over algebraically closed characteristic-two field, not a classification of every Steiner surface or universal deformation invariant.
